Name: Stones
Description: Controls the overall size of the stones. Higher values produce larger stones, while lower values create finer gravel.

Name: Scale
Description: Controls the overall size of the stones. Higher values produce larger stones, while lower values create finer gravel.

Name: Height
Description: Sets the maximum elevation or prominence of the stones above the terrain surface.

Name: Density
Description: Adjusts how many stones are scattered across the surface. Higher values increase the number of stones per area.

Name: Seed
Description: Randomization seed for stone placement and variation. Changing the seed produces different stone patterns.
